name: Ralph Waldo Emerson
contribution: An American essayist, lecturer, philosopher, minister, abolitionist, and poet who led the transcendentalist movement of the mid-19th century.
legacy: His speech "The American Scholar", given in 1837, was called America's "intellectual Declaration of Independence" by Oliver Holmes.

checks.lead: Ralph Waldo Emerson (May 25, 1803 – April 27, 1882), who went by his middle name Waldo, was an American essayist, lecturer, philosopher, minister, abolitionist, and poet who led the transcendentalist movement of the mid-19th century. He was seen as a prescient critic of the countervailing pressures of society and conformity.
